description: Department of Labour - Notifying that the Cost of Living Index Number for the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing Trade for the Month of December 2015 being 115.0, the Special Allowance in respect of a normal working day in the Month of January, 2016 will be Rs. 650.58
categorisation: This gazette notification announces a special allowance for workers in specific agricultural trades, which falls under public sector service conditions and benefits. It is issued by the Commissioner General of Labour and relates to wage regulations for workers, making it a Public Service Gazette (Type 8) rather than a government structure/personnel matter.
